typed_finding_first.old_corpus_gap: the post-cutoff corpus committed NO per-item DOI/abstract bytes (the item keys: item_id/public_date/publisher/title_for_record/served/ground_truth) — a fresh-from-source GT re-authoring REQUIRES the sources back
typed_finding_first.fix: Crossref works API query BY TITLE (read-only, the polite pool, zero quota); per-item: the fetched DOI, abstract (JATS-stripped), publisher, date, the Crossref relevance score — committed as eval/r110_d3_corpus_source/fetched_abstracts.jsonl BEFORE any authoring call; a missed/ambiguous match types the item OUT (the item set and n reported)

arms.GT_author: agnes-3.0-flash — NOT a judge family (the judges stay zai/J1 + xkiro/cohere/J2); ONE authoring call per item from the FETCHED abstract; schema: background_question, background_survey, inspiration_papers (2-4, titles only), main_hypothesis, finegrained_hypothesis, key_elements (4-6 atomic mechanism components), distractors (3 plausible-but-wrong mechanisms)
arms.engine_arm: the rediscovery protocol's generator_prompt over the NEW served material — ONE agnes generation per item, temperature 0.0 (the same one-generation contract as the rerun)
arms.bare_arm: the SAME served material, a minimal directive ('state your hypothesis', no engine scaffolding, no plans/critic/repair), ONE agnes generation per item, temperature 0.0
arms.leakage_controls: the GT fields and key_elements never enter any generation prompt; the paper titles in served inspirations are the preregistered served set (the generator saw them in both arms equally)

metrics_judge_free.graded_key_element_recall: |{e in key_elements: max-cos(gen_text, e) >= tau}| / |key_elements|; the matcher = the SAME deterministic SPECTER2 stack; tau is calibrated on the corpus's OWN pairs BEFORE any generation exists: positives = (element, its own GT text), negatives = (element, OTHER items' GT texts); tau = the midpoint between the max negative and the min positive, recorded at calibration time with both distributions; the per-element matched/unmatched table is committed for the auditor's spot check
metrics_judge_free.hypothesis_ranking: the generation's hypothesis vs its 3 distractors, ranked by cosine to the GT main_hypothesis; hit@1 and MRR — judge-free (pure embedding ranking)
metrics_judge_free.survey_faithfulness: the same graded recall against the SERVED survey's key sentences (the background the arms actually saw) — a guard metric: a generation that ignores the served material scores low even if fluent

comparison.primary: engine-minus-bare on graded key-element recall, paired per item; the 95% CI from the paired percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 110, computed by code, never by hand); the same interval for hit@1 and survey-faithfulness
comparison.typed: NO comparison to the 0.0667 3-class number (a different corpus + a different metric — the auditor's delete list removes the 3-class count as the only score-9 metric); no score-9 acceptance is claimed — the instrument result is staged for the auditor

quota_disclosure_estimate: ~30 Crossref reads (free) + ~95 agnes calls (30 author + 30 engine + 30 bare + repairs, 2-key rotation); zero judge-family calls
determinism: the SPECTER2 stack is the committed cache path, eval mode; the bootstrap seed is fixed; all raw bytes (authorings, generations, per-element match tables) committed verbatim for the fresh-clone rule
anti_tuning: this prereg lands BEFORE stage A; changes after the first generation byte are typed findings; the tau calibration happens BEFORE any generation exists (no generation-dependent threshold)
